note: اطلاع centrally means information/notice/notification/news. 'Advice' is not the ordinary direct meaning and should not lead the entry.
پیسے is an inflected/plural form of پیسہ and in ordinary Urdu very commonly means money. The source gives only inflection labels and no lexical meaning.
رہنا means to stay/remain/live/reside and also helps form progressive constructions. The source omits the basic stay/remain senses.
proposed_english: to stay; to remain; to live; to reside; progressive auxiliary use

note: سلامتی centrally means safety/security/well-being. 'Health, cheers' is awkward/noisy learner English.
امکان centrally means possibility/chance/likelihood/feasibility. The source's 'control; means, courage; contingent existence' omits the normal modern meaning.
تصویر centrally means picture/image/photo/portrait/representation. 'Condition, state' is erroneous source contamination.
خالی centrally means empty/vacant/free/bare and can function adverbially as only/merely. The source omits plain 'empty'.
مستقل means permanent/constant/stable/regular. 'Complete' is not a normal direct meaning.
پس means therefore/so/then and, in another Persian-derived spatial reading, behind/after. 'Closed-class' is too vague.
جذبہ means emotion/feeling/sentiment and very commonly passion/drive. The current gloss is valid but incomplete for a learner.
مقامی means local/native as an adjective and local resident as a noun. Noun use is missing from POS.
اچانک means suddenly/unexpectedly/all of a sudden. 'Dramatic' is not a direct meaning and should be removed.
proposed_english: suddenly; unexpectedly; all of a sudden

note: نقل means copy/imitation/transcription/quotation and can mean transfer/transport in compounds. 'Print, printing' is too narrow and not the main sense.
پنجابی means Punjabi as an adjective, the Punjabi language, or a Punjabi person. 'Name' POS does not capture the noun/language use.
فصل means crop/harvest and also season/chapter/section. 'Farm' is not a direct meaning; chapter/section is a common learner sense.
مغرب means west/the West and Maghrib (sunset/time/prayer). Morocco is المغرب in Arabic but is not the normal Urdu lexical meaning of مغرب and should not be mixed into this entry.
proposed_english: west; the West; sunset/Maghrib time; Maghrib prayer

note: آنا centrally means to come/arrive. It can express knowing how in constructions such as مجھے تیرنا آتا ہے, but 'to know' is not an unqualified direct translation.
proposed_english: to come; to arrive; to know how (in ability constructions, context-dependent)
